description: Contract version manifest and the frozen payload of the `status --json` contracts discovery field. One call tells a consumer which contract versions this CLI implements.

discovery.note: mcpProtocol is the negotiated/default legacy protocol; allowed values are listed in mcp/versions-v1.json supportedProtocolVersions. exitCodes stays 1 until exit-codes-v2.draft.json is activated with the policy engine.

Error codes preserved in errors/codes.v1.json external section; the DSH output schemas stay additive.
